title: Fppf local square roots of units
statement: Let $T$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $s\in\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)^\times$ a global unit. There is an fppf covering $\{f_i:T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] and units $r_i\in\Gamma(T_i,\mathcal O_{T_i})^\times$ such that $r_i^2=f_i^*s$ for every $i$. No invertibility assumption on $2$ and no reducedness hypothesis on $T$ is imposed.

source.place: Stacks Tag 040N, lemma-kummer-sequence-syntomic, surjectivity of the power map for n=2; proof by the finite free cover defined by T^2-s.

proof.text: Put $A=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$, let $\alpha:A\to B=A[x]/(x^2-s)$ be the quotient structure map, and write $b$ for the class of $x$. Then $b^2=\alpha(s)$. Apply [lem-sfb-monic-quotient-faithful-tensor-coordinates] with $d=2$, $a_0=-s$ and $a_1=0$: $A\to B$ is faithfully flat, including when $A$ is the zero ring. The quotient and its relation are those of [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient].

source.place: Tag 040N, lemma-kummer-sequence-syntomic, proof of local surjectivity with n=2; the fppf assertion only needs flatness and finite presentation.

proof.text: Let $q=\operatorname{Spec}\alpha:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Faithful flatness implies flatness [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], so $q$ is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-iff-flat-affine], and $q$ is surjective by [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-surjective-spectrum]. The single-generator single-relation presentation $B=A[x]/(x^2-s)$ makes $q$ locally of finite presentation directly by [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], taking the whole affine source and target as neighbourhoods at every source point. Thus $\{q\}$ is an fppf covering by [def-pc-fppf-site].

source.place: Tag 040N, lemma-kummer-sequence-syntomic, proof of local surjectivity with n=2; the fppf assertion only needs flatness and finite presentation.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme], the identity of $A$ gives $j:T\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ with $j^*\varepsilon_A=\mathrm{id}_A$, where $\varepsilon_A:A\cong\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}A,\mathcal O)$ is the canonical isomorphism. Form $V=T\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}B$ with projections $f:V\to T$ and $h:V\to\operatorname{Spec}B$, so $jf=qh$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. The singleton $\{f\}$ is an fppf covering by [lem-trf-fppf-covering-base-change] applied to $\{q\}$ and $j$.

source.place: Tag 040N, lemma-kummer-sequence-syntomic, proof of local surjectivity with n=2; the fppf assertion only needs flatness and finite presentation.

proof.text: Put $r=h^*\varepsilon_B(b)\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$. The naturality formula $q^*\varepsilon_A=\varepsilon_B\alpha$ of [lem-weil-pbc-spec-map-global-sections] and the pullback square give $r^2=h^*\varepsilon_B(b^2)=h^*\varepsilon_B\alpha(s)=h^*q^*\varepsilon_A(s)=f^*j^*\varepsilon_A(s)=f^*s$. Since $s$ is a unit, $r\,\bigl(r f^*(s^{-1})\bigr)=r^2f^*(s^{-1})=f^*(ss^{-1})=1$, so $r$ is a unit with the displayed inverse. Take $I$ to be a singleton and $(T_i,f_i,r_i)=(V,f,r)$. These calculations also apply to the empty scheme, and use neither division by $2$ nor reducedness.
